commits.subject: storage: establish integrity schema and freeze bootstrap
commits.message:
storage: establish integrity schema and freeze bootstrap

Add the final additive foundation schema in one migration, including
catalog identity, observer evidence, and API actor audit constraints.
Keep strict attempt provenance paired and immutable from creation.

Bootstrap the singleton after fresh schema loads while preserving the
upgrade migration insert. Add focused migration, model, and bootstrap
coverage for both paths.
commits.disposition: retained previously published/externally consumed predecessor lineage

commits.subject: storage: journal observer writes across API and NodeCtld
commits.message:
storage: journal observer writes across API and NodeCtld

Classify storage handles in paired v4 registries and serialize
read-only admission with chain staging. Record affected scopes and
targets, and retain receipts for guarded snapshot commands.

Settle terminal observer intents without claiming physical proof.
Expose bounded database drain status and reject node retries that
could bypass admission. Production strict dispatch stays off.
commits.disposition: retained previously published/externally consumed predecessor lineage

commits.subject: storage: add advisory inventory and reconciliation
commits.message:
storage: add advisory inventory and reconciliation

Capture a sealed API DB view and signed, two-pass NodeCtld zpool
inventory through bounded Rabbit transport. Compare evidence and
write deterministic, non-executable plans as private artifacts.

Route handle 5290 through the node inventory queue while retaining
the persisted storage queue for mixed-version refusal. Cover replay,
comparison, planning and queue behavior in focused specs.
commits.disposition: retained previously published/externally consumed predecessor lineage

commits.subject: storage: add authenticated freeze API and WebUI
commits.message:
storage: add authenticated freeze API and WebUI

Require an active, direct administrator session for mode changes and
observer catch-up. Bind epoch checks and actor audit to the locked
freeze control. Keep status reads free of catch-up writes.

Show bounded database drain status in the WebUI and review mode changes
before submission. Add API, model, UI, locale and CI coverage.
commits.disposition: retained previously published/externally consumed predecessor lineage

commits.subject: storage: prove strict snapshot dispatch in test mode
commits.message:
storage: prove strict snapshot dispatch in test mode

Add pre-dispatch proof and durable attempt receipts for guarded 5204 and
5215 execution and rollback. Close only chains with supported, proved
members; fatal refusal retains locks and signatures.

Keep strict dispatch constructor-only for tests. Exercise API-produced
5215 v4 manifests against NodeCtld in a disposable database contract,
including partial compensation and malformed target refusal.
commits.disposition: retained previously published/externally consumed predecessor lineage

commits.subject: storage: document integrity evidence and observer limits
commits.message:
storage: document integrity evidence and observer limits

Describe catalog identity, observer admission, attempt evidence, and
freeze/drain semantics. Document the private advisory capture and plan
interface with its proof limits. Link the reference pages and require
final-series review before treating an unmerged branch as ready.
commits.disposition: retained previously published/externally consumed predecessor lineage

commits.subject: nodectld: observe bounded local storage activity
commits.message:
nodectld: observe bounded local storage activity

Track queue workers, reservations and registered child blockers with a
daemon boot identity and an effect generation. Bound snapshots across
queue locks so a stalled reservation yields unknown instead of hanging.

Keep child coverage unknown until all spawn and reap paths are proved.
This provider does not change freeze admission or repair authority.
commits.disposition: retained previously published/externally consumed predecessor lineage

commits.subject: storage: preserve exact GUIDs in signed inventory
commits.message:
storage: preserve exact GUIDs in signed inventory

Consume the node catalog result through its cursor so inventory validation
checks every managed root. Canonicalize integral DECIMAL Pool GUIDs when
capturing database evidence, then carry the same digits into the signed
inventory request and physical comparison. Reject fractional GUIDs.
commits.disposition: retained previously published/externally consumed predecessor lineage

commits.subject: storage: sample node and osctld activity around inventory
commits.message:
storage: sample node and osctld activity around inventory

Add signed read-only 5291 probes that bind the freeze epoch and complete
Pool claims, with bounded local osctld reads and node activity samples.
Bracket private two-pass inventory with probes and record an incomplete
advisory report without granting quietness or repair authority.

Keep the persisted storage queue for old-node refusal. Prompt for the
signing key when the process is locked and reuse it across Pool captures.
Cover deadlines and malformed replies.
commits.disposition: retained previously published/externally consumed predecessor lineage

commits.subject: storage: accept capped settled intents in activity reports
commits.message:
storage: accept capped settled intents in activity reports

StorageFreezeStatus excludes settled_unverified_intents from DB drain
blockers, but ActivityReport rejected every capped relation. Permit only
that informational count while retaining the stable read-only epoch and
all blocking-count gates.
commits.disposition: retained previously published/externally consumed predecessor lineage

commits.subject: Distinguish completed rollbacks in DB capture overlap
commits.message:
Distinguish completed rollbacks in DB capture overlap

Use terminal chain state, full member coverage and persisted direction
results to identify completed rollbacks. Keep incomplete or ambiguous
storage transactions as overlap blockers. Parse only bounded result data
inside the capture transaction and omit transaction payloads from the
private artifact.
commits.disposition: retained previously published/externally consumed predecessor lineage

commits.subject: Keep storage reconciliation replay cold and offline
commits.message:
Keep storage reconciliation replay cold and offline

Load artifact helpers for compare, dry-run and plan after CLI parsing.
Defer API boot to capture and activity-report so offline replay avoids
SysConfig startup DB access. Verify a sealed capture in a fresh Ruby
process without ActiveRecord.
commits.disposition: retained previously published/externally consumed predecessor lineage

commits.subject: api: canonicalize captured storage GUID decimals
commits.message:
api: canonicalize captured storage GUID decimals

Serialize every captured storage GUID and owner GUID DECIMAL as plain
unsigned digits within the uint64 range. ActiveRecord BigDecimal values
otherwise use exponent notation, which breaks exact catalog and ZFS GUID
comparisons. Reject invalid values before publishing DB evidence.

The evidence format and database schema are unchanged. Recapture older
evidence when exact GUID comparison is needed.
commits.disposition: retained previously published/externally consumed predecessor lineage

commits.subject: storage: version offline coverage conservatively
commits.message:
storage: version offline coverage conservatively

Read sealed v1 captures with unknown historical and selector coverage.
Validate future bounded v2 manifests and write policy 2 and plan 3
reports. Keep the capture writer and Node protocol on version 1 until
the bounded selectors land.
commits.disposition: retained previously published/externally consumed predecessor lineage

commits.subject: Bound storage reconciler capture to current evidence
commits.message:
Bound storage reconciler capture to current evidence

Select pending snapshot targets and observable node work with bounded
closure instead of scanning terminal history. Keep unrelated pending
confirmation payloads out of the private artifact.

Add three selector indexes and row and byte budgets. Seal manifest v2
with explicit unknown historical coverage while retaining v1 reads.
commits.disposition: retained previously published/externally consumed predecessor lineage

commits.subject: Restore pooled DB isolation after storage capture
commits.message:
Restore pooled DB isolation after storage capture

Set the session isolation to repeatable read before starting the read-only
snapshot, then restore its original level before publishing DB evidence.
MariaDB reports the session default through @@tx_isolation, so a transaction-
only override was rejected on services using read committed and prevented
all 5290 captures. Reject unknown original levels and keep failures incomplete.
commits.disposition: retained previously published/externally consumed predecessor lineage

commits.subject: api: avoid fixture IP address collisions
commits.message:
api: avoid fixture IP address collisions

The export spec helper derived a candidate from the maximum row ID.
Rolled-back transactions can advance auto-increment IDs and make that
candidate collide with an existing address. Select an unused address in
the fixture network and cover a repeated starting candidate.
commits.disposition: retained previously published/externally consumed predecessor lineage

commits.subject: Use the shared transient node exchange for inventory
commits.message:
Use the shared transient node exchange for inventory

The normal NodeCtld and Supervisor publishers declare each node exchange as
transient. The inventory receiver and sender instead requested a durable
exchange, so RabbitMQ refused the signed 5290 transport before dispatch.
Declare the existing exchange in both inventory endpoints with the same
properties as the other node traffic. Keep the durable bounded reply queue.
commits.disposition: retained previously published/externally consumed predecessor lineage

commits.subject: api: support bounded scheduler intervals and task refresh
commits.message:
api: support bounded scheduler intervals and task refresh

Accept stepped wildcard and inclusive stepped range fields so repeatable
tasks can run at short, offset intervals. Reject invalid fields and retain
the previous complete task set when a database row cannot be loaded.

Make task reload frequency configurable while keeping the three-hour
default. Deploy scheduler support before introducing interval schedules;
remove those schedules before rolling back to an older scheduler.
commits.disposition: retained previously published/externally consumed predecessor lineage

commits.subject: api: serialize dataset plan membership and retain shared templates
commits.message:
api: serialize dataset plan membership and retain shared templates

Guard plan registration, removal and template configuration through storage
admission and a persisted Plan lock. Check source locks and pending chain
confirmations for direct API calls as well as nested transaction chains.

Add the default-false keep_empty_group_snapshots option for separately
provisioned shared templates. Keep their action and task on last removal,
validate repeat enrollment and preserve legacy first-open backup selection.
Expose confirmation chain identity through a read-only accessor.

Normalize validated numeric schedule fields to their persisted strings so
enrollment, shared-task reuse and removal compare the same schedule.

Deploy scheduler and Plan support before enabling retained-template plans.
Retire their memberships and schedules before returning to older Plan code.
commits.disposition: retained previously published/externally consumed predecessor lineage

commits.subject: nodectld: retire failed RPC channels during recovery
commits.message:
nodectld: retire failed RPC channels during recovery

Keep this RPC call's exception when cleanup also fails, and report
cleanup-only failures with their transport cause. Make close one-shot
and retire channels from failed constructors and cleanup.

Serialize channel lifecycle operations and gate publication until the
old transport, reader and consumer workers are stopped and the exact
channel is excluded from Bunny recovery. Late retirement requests stay
pending. Bound RPC recovery waits and support cooperative stop without
discarding retirement; ordinary required publishers wait for the gate.

Preserve the previous complete storage catalog after a known RPC failure
and publish a replacement only after fetch and cleanup succeed.
Programming and permanent broker errors remain visible. The API wire
and schema stay unchanged.
commits.disposition: retained previously published/externally consumed predecessor lineage

commits.subject: tests: verify remote restore payloads across persistent queue settings
commits.message:
tests: verify remote restore payloads across persistent queue settings

Persist zero transfer delays in the remote-restore scenario and prove they
survive a graceful daemon restart before its transaction chains start.
Keep production queue defaults unchanged and remove transient repatching.

Verify distinct payloads in two remote backup snapshots, their absence
after reinstall, restoration of the second payload and a later incremental
backup with a third payload. Bind the incremental base to transaction
evidence, destination receive history, snapshot GUIDs and branch topology.

Record bounded chain, queue, daemon and error projections on failure without
replacing the original error or dumping configuration and signed requests.
commits.disposition: retained previously published/externally consumed predecessor lineage

commits.subject: api: Reserve frozen storage admission with retained audit
commits.message:
api: Reserve frozen storage admission with retained audit

Compatible API callers need a durable owner before a maintenance
workflow can rely on storage remaining read-only. Add one reservation
row and the singleton owner pointer, serialized with ordinary mode
changes and staged admission. The API can reserve, inspect and abandon
an unused contract 1 reservation; it dispatches no Node work or physical
maintenance operation.

Copy the exact requested Pool/Node catalog scope and both administrator
identities. Keep UUID replay bound to the actor, epoch and immutable
scope, and use revision/digest CAS for abandonment without changing mode
or epoch. Never expire ownership after disconnect or timeout.
Unsupported records fail closed and completed audit remains retained,
including on downgrade.

The additive schema does not fence old mode setters. Compatible API,
Supervisor, scheduler/task and administrative readers must converge
before relying on ownership; rollback with an active reservation is
unsupported. Physical exclusion, capture approval and executable repair
remain separate.
commits.disposition: one new unpublished reservation owner; equivalent receiver/comment cleanup and direct reviewed endpoint-manifest omission folded into owner; consumed predecessor intact
